title: Tune without a
intro: Observability toggles apply on the next <0>/v1/*</0> request. Plugin intents persist to <1>config.json</1>; if a plugin is not installed in this build, the switch records operator preference only.

runtime.logClientRequestBodyHint: Attach payloads received from clients to request_records.
runtime.logUpstreamRequestBodyHint: Attach payloads sent to upstream providers after router/provider adaptation.
runtime.logUpstreamResponseBodyHint: Attach payloads returned by upstream providers to request_records.
runtime.logRetentionHint: Days to keep request records and logs before automatic cleanup. 1–365.
runtime.logLevelHint: Minimum slog level emitted by the router.
runtime.modelRenamesHint: Exact client model ids rewritten before upstream forwarding.

validation.retentionRange: Log retention must be between 1 and 365 days.
validation.renameMax: Each side must be at most 128 characters, up to 32 renames.

admin_auth.label: Admin authentication
admin_auth.description: Records whether admin authentication should be enabled once that plugin is available. This build still uses the trusted-network admin boundary.

client_keys.label: Client API keys
client_keys.description: Records whether per-caller /v1/* keys should be enforced once that plugin is available.

plugins.notInstalled: Plugin not yet installed — flipping the switch only records operator intent in <0>config.json</0>.

proxy.label: Proxy URL
proxy.hint: Single global egress proxy (http/https/socks5/socks5h), e.g. socks5://127.0.0.1:7890

toasts.updateFailed: Update failed — see the banner for details
toasts.proxyFailed: Could not update the outbound proxy
toasts.proxyReachable: Proxy reachable — the upstream responded through it
